committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 11 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Raw landing-page clicks sit at 17 against A$106.75 spent, about A$6.28 per click, in line with the roughly A$6 test estimate, while last7 conversions stayed at 0.
Click-through rate fell to 2.2% from 3.1% even as impressions rose to 1,030 from 733 and clicks held flat at 23, worth watching before drawing conclusions.

Of the 25 sessions logged on /free-workflow-review.html since the test began, only 3 ask_cta_click events have fired and zero review_cta_click events, so the raw ask-form interest still needs grading against the qualified rule.
AI Assistant sessions rose to 4 from 1 last7, led by claude-check, but this still undercounts true AI referral since many such clicks land in Direct, which itself fell to 16 from 31 sessions.

actions.text: Raw paid clicks on the landing page have crossed 10 (now 17), review search terms and Clarity recordings now and log any exclusions in the test log.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
